# opennbLM

> Open-source, local-first Windows study app in the spirit of Google NotebookLM. You keep your own files in a notebook, attach a teaching model you already use, and generate Studio work on this PC. There is no opennbLM account and no bundled LLM.

This file is the short brief for language models. The live site is https://opennblm.manasdutta.com/. The product is the Windows desktop app, not a web workspace. Developed by Manas Dutta with Xiaa.

## What it is

opennbLM is an Electron + React desktop app. Create a notebook, add PDFs, links, or pasted text, connect a teaching brain, then chat or generate Studio artifacts from the sources you selected.

It is bring-your-own-brain. Settings does not take API keys. You open a notebook, click Connect brain, and pick an engine already installed or signed in on that computer: Claude, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Ollama, or LM Studio. Cloud CLIs send selected excerpts to that vendor. Ollama and LM Studio keep inference on the machine.

Notebooks, chats, notes, and generated audio stay in the app data folder. The marketing site is static and never receives those files.

## Studio

Studio builds from the selected sources, not from a generic chat dump. Language is a Studio picker. The seven delivery languages are English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, and Punjabi.

- Notebooks
- Audio Overview (the only path that speaks)
- Mind map
- Infographic
- Quiz
- Flashcards
- Slides
- Report and data table also exist in the app

Chat is text only. Rumik must not read chat.

Memory stores teaching notes only after a brain answers a question. Creating a notebook or generating Studio does not fill Memory.

## Voice (Rumik)

Rumik OSS-1 (`rumik-ai/rumik-oss-1`) is the only voice engine. It is not a generic TTS marketplace.

- Remote (default after the .exe): the app calls the public Space at https://rumik-ai-rumik-oss-1.hf.space over HTTPS. Users do not clone Rumik or start a server. A Hugging Face token is optional when anonymous ZeroGPU quota runs out.
- Local (this PC): NVIDIA CUDA + official weights bound from Settings → Voice engine. Preferred when a GPU is available.

Local load can use automatic 4-bit NF4 (bitsandbytes) on cards with ≤6 GB VRAM. That is reachability, not higher quality than full precision. This path was proven on an RTX 3050 Ti laptop with 4 GB VRAM.

If the user chooses local, synthesis stays on that PC. A local worker failure does not silently fall over to the public Space.

Speakers are Ira, Aisha, Siya, and Zoya. Pace is steady. Accent follows the line language. The UI does not offer tone, accent, or pace pickers. Rumik OSS-1 weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 (research / non-commercial). Application source is Apache 2.0.

English Studio and chat are the reliable path. Indic Audio Overview is limited by rumik-oss-1. A larger GPU makes it faster, not more natural. Do not claim this matches a commercial NotebookLM + TTS stack.

## How a person uses it

1. Install the Windows x64 NSIS build from GitHub Releases. Do not clone the repo to use the product.
2. First launch walks through this PC, a teaching brain, and optional voice.
3. Create a notebook. Connect brain. Add sources. Select them.
4. Ask in chat or generate Studio one tool at a time.
5. Optional: play Audio Overview. Optional: read Memory after a real answer.

## Do not say

- That opennbLM ships a built-in teaching model or stores vendor API keys in Settings
- That chat is spoken, or that Rumik runs on macOS locally
- That Indic speech is solved
- That remote voice means the user hosts Rumik
- That 4-bit local load sounds better than full precision
